description: Change the text of a Discord message Hermoso posted (≤2000 characters) — the bot's or the announcement webhook's. Pass messageId exactly as post_to_discord returned it. Mentions never ping on an edit. Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

channel.description: the channel, when messageId is a bare id of a BOT post

messageId.description: the message id post_to_discord returned (a bot post's is "<channel>/<message>")

name: edit_discord_message
title: Edit a Discord announcement
